# Deltakit 0.9.0 with the subpackages it was released with (2026-07-09). Its
# metapackage only sets their minimums, so an unpinned install gets today's.
# Used by the deltakit job in .github/workflows/tests.yml.
deltakit==0.9.0
deltakit-circuit==0.9.0
deltakit-core==0.9.0
deltakit-decode==0.9.0
deltakit-explorer==0.9.0
# Released with 0.2.0, which crashes once Stim is imported too, as this package
# does (deltakit#310). 0.2.4 fixed it; deltakit-circuit 0.9.0 allows >=0.2,<0.3.
deltakit-stim==0.2.4
